topic: HTTP cache validators and conditional revalidation
original_claims_contract:
## Claims file field contract (no factual example)
Write one JSON OBJECT using actual researched content:
concept: exact CONCEPT string above. summary: string, maximum160 words; count saved words.
claims: ARRAY of objects with text,confidence,section,sources(URL ARRAY),volatile(boolean).
confidence: high|medium|low. section: core|tools|methodology|patterns|antipatterns|troubleshooting.
Include at least TWO distinct substantive load-bearing core claims at high/medium confidence.
Each such core cites at least TWO distinct ACTUALLY READ URLs supporting every clause.
Do not relabel unsupported patterns as core or invent claims to fill a count.
All cited URLs must appear in sources: ARRAY of objects with url,title,tier.
tier: docs|paper|postmortem|blog|forum|repo. A volatile claim also has verified_as_of YYYY-MM-DD.
Use THREE independent originating organizations per concept; mirrors of one origin count once.
Search snippets, headings and questions are not substantive deep reads. Recover supporting passages
with short literal read_source terms taken from headings/text; vary the source if a read is unproductive.
Perform the original negation round and substantive reads, even when no disagreement is found.
disagreements: ARRAY of objects with text,sources(URL ARRAY); use [] when none is evidenced.
open_questions and child_concepts: STRING ARRAYS. Keep unsupported details UNVERIFIED.
telemetry: OBJECT with honest integer queries,negation_queries,sources_deep_read.
Actually Write the JSON, deterministically validate its saved shape/counts, then run the exact
concept-done command. Fix rejected files and RETRY that command. Chat JSON is not handoff.
After two broadened query rounds still fail the authority floor, use concept-block with the actual
gap; never fabricate sources or claims. This is standard depth, cap8, with no saturation loop.
typed_transport_contract:
## Claims file field contract (no factual example)
Write one JSON OBJECT using actual researched content:
concept: exact CONCEPT string above. summary: string, maximum160 words; count saved words.
claims: ARRAY of objects with text,confidence,section,sources(SOURCE_HANDLE ARRAY; relay resolves final fetched URLs),volatile(boolean).
confidence: high|medium|low. section: core|tools|methodology|patterns|antipatterns|troubleshooting.
Include at least TWO distinct substantive load-bearing core claims at high/medium confidence.
Each such core cites at least TWO distinct ACTUALLY READ URLs supporting every clause.
Do not relabel unsupported patterns as core or invent claims to fill a count.
All cited source handles must appear in sources: ARRAY of objects with source_handle,title,tier.
tier: docs|paper|postmortem|blog|forum|repo. A volatile claim also has verified_as_of YYYY-MM-DD.
Use THREE independent originating organizations per concept; mirrors of one origin count once.
Search snippets, headings and questions are not substantive deep reads. Recover supporting passages
with short literal read_source terms taken from headings/text; vary the source if a read is unproductive.
Perform the original negation round and substantive reads, even when no disagreement is found.
disagreements: ARRAY of objects with text,sources(SOURCE_HANDLE ARRAY; relay resolves final fetched URLs); use [] when none is evidenced.
open_questions and child_concepts: STRING ARRAYS. Keep unsupported details UNVERIFIED.
telemetry: OBJECT with honest integer queries,negation_queries,sources_deep_read.
Actually publish your authored document with publish_claims. The unchanged relay writes canonical JSON with resolved fetched URLs and runs the exact concept-done command. Fix your own rejected submission and RETRY; chat prose is not handoff.
After two broadened query rounds still fail the authority floor, use concept-block with the actual
gap; never fabricate sources or claims. This is standard depth, cap8, with no saturation loop.

Transport distinction: publish_claims uses issued handles; the final canonical file uses resolved fetched URLs. Obtain observed metadata for your explicit selections via observed_research(view=2) before publication. Copy honest counters; fill factual blanks yourself. No automatic citation/fact repair exists.
